channel.title: Agent Stack Brief · English
channel.description: AI agent tools: changes, practical decisions, and exercises.

item.title: 004 · Restore the same skills and review change specs
item.description:
• Skills CLI 1.9.0 can record installed Git commits. Verify lockfile restore in a clean checkout.
  • MCP Skills extension v0.1.0 beta publishes a file verification specification and schema. Check extension support in your target host.
  • OpenSpec 2.1.1 installs skills bundled with the CLI. Trial spec review on a small change.

item.title: 003 · What agents can read and why they stop
item.description:
• Skill Scanner 2.3.2 aligns LLM inputs across presets; compare static findings and LLM verdicts separately.
  • Fetch MCP 2026.11.4 adds an opt-in host allowlist. Verify allowed and denied destinations in a test environment.
  • Deep Agents SDK 0.7.33 raises model refusals by default; 0.7.35 fixes forked subagent cache prefixes and symlink display.

item.title: 002 · Make agent work observable
item.description:
• Skill Scanner 2.3.0 reports unscanned symlinks and load failures; review CI rules.
  • Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11.0 diagnostics; separate DevTools UI and Docs MCP documentation-review cases.
  • Deep Agents 0.7.26–0.7.28 improves async status reporting and glob path handling.

item.title: 001 · Before adding tools, check the boundaries
item.description:
• agent-browser 0.39.1 prevents duplicate execution after a lost response; inspect before retrying.
  • Deep Agents 0.7.25 checks path permissions with symlink targets in mind.
  • Skill Scanner 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 fixes: update the scanner before reviewing third-party skills.
